data.taskBrief:
TASK BRIEF: Resumable YouTube video upload initiation for a private MP4 using Google APIs (Google)

FIT
Partially. This request starts a resumable upload for a YouTube video and lets you set snippet/status metadata, including private visibility. However, no supplied request covers OAuth authentication, sending the file bytes, handling interruption/resuming the session, disabling subscriber notifications, or verifying post-upload processing.

AUTH
No authentication scheme is specified in the supplied request or collection, so no auth header/param can be inferred.

BASE URL
https://www.googleapis.com

STEPS
1. POST /upload/youtube/v3/videos?part=snippet,status&uploadType=resumable
   Params:
   - Query part: string — `snippet,status` — goes in the query string.
   - Query uploadType: string — `resumable` — goes in the query string.
   - Body (raw JSON):
     - snippet.file: string — example `"/path/to/video.mp4"` — goes in the JSON body.
     - snippet.title: string — example `"My private upload"` — goes in the JSON body.
     - status.privacyStatus: string — example `"private"` — goes in the JSON body.
     - status.madeForKids: boolean — example `false` — goes in the JSON body.
   Returns:
   - No response example is provided, so the saved responses do not show the status code, response headers, or body fields.
   Threading:
   - None

GOTCHAS
- The request is a resumable upload initiation call only; it does not show the follow-up upload of the media bytes or any resume logic.
- No OAuth details are present, so the required authorization header or token exchange is not specified here.
- The body is shown as raw JSON, but the `file` value appears inside `snippet`; treat it as literal schema content, not as a verified YouTube field contract.
- There is no field here for subscriber notification control, and no request to verify processing status after upload.
